name: studio
description: Description-driven root Producer that selects host-provided skills and coordinates role-based native crews.

interface.shortDescription: Select suitable skills and manage role-based native subagents.
interface.longDescription: Studio keeps the main Producer on the control plane, compares mission needs with descriptions in the host-provided skill catalog, applies optional user routing and role-specific model/effort policy, and dispatches native leaf crews without embedding another plugin's workflow or state.
defaultPrompt: Use $execute in the root Producer session to select skills from their public descriptions and run the mission.
Use $producer to cast the smallest useful crew and keep orchestration out of leaf agents.
Treat .studio.yml execution entries as user policy, then load and follow every selected SKILL.md in full.
